metaData.originalTitle: 将 DSA 注意力引入多模态，快手 Keye2.0 开启强化推理新范式
metaData.title: Introducing DSA Attention to Multimodal Models: Kuaishou Keye 2.0 Opens a New Paradigm for Enhanced Reasoning
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou has released the Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B multimodal large language model, which for the first time introduces the DSA sparse attention mechanism to the multimodal domain. It achieves lossless inference with a 256K ultra-long context and unlocks Agent collaboration capabilities, reaching SOTA performance among models of its size on tasks such as long video temporal understanding, code generation, and tool invocation.
metaData.summary: This article is an official technical blog post from the Kuaishou AI team, detailing the core technological breakthroughs of their latest multimodal large language model, Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B. It first identifies the pain points of long video understanding: the computational bottleneck and information dilution caused by ultra-long visual contexts. Keye-VL-2.0 addresses this by being the first to apply the DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) architecture in a multimodal setting, combining sparse attention with feature aggregation. This enables deep perception of a 256K ultra-long context, achieving results on video understanding benchmarks like TimeLens and LongVideoBench that surpass closed-source models like Gemini and comparable open-source models. Secondly, the model natively incorporates an Agent collaboration mechanism, demonstrating system-level execution potential in scenarios like Code Agent and Tool Agent. It overcomes catastrophic forgetting in multi-task learning through the innovative MOPD multi-expert policy distillation technique, leading to a comprehensive surge in general capabilities. Finally, the article introduces the Context-RL reward mechanism and a rigorous data engine used in the post-training phase to ensure inference reliability, and discusses the model's potential applications in real-world business scenarios such as Kuaishou's recommendation system and video material production.

mainPoints.point: First to introduce the DSA sparse attention mechanism to the multimodal domain, breaking the bottleneck of long video understanding.
mainPoints.explanation: Keye-VL-2.0 applies DeepSeek Sparse Attention, combining sparse attention with feature aggregation. When processing hour-long videos, it effectively purifies information, enabling lossless inference over a 256K ultra-long context. It surpasses closed-source models like Gemini on benchmarks such as TimeLens.

mainPoints.point: Built-in Agent collaboration mechanism, enabling a full perception-planning-execution pipeline.
mainPoints.explanation: The model natively unlocks Agent capabilities, demonstrating multi-step task decomposition and automated scheduling potential in scenarios like Code Agent (SWE-bench 62.00) and Tool Agent (TAU2-Bench 82.58), moving towards solving real-world complex tasks.

mainPoints.point: Innovative MOPD multi-expert policy distillation technique overcomes catastrophic forgetting.
mainPoints.explanation: Through the cross-modal MOPD technique, it integrates expert models from various vertical domains. It also introduces a novel bucketed advantage scaling method that strengthens core reasoning signals while ensuring multi-task fusion does not compromise the general base model's capabilities, achieving a comprehensive explosion of capabilities across all dimensions.

mainPoints.point: Introduces the Context-RL reward mechanism to build inference reliability.
mainPoints.explanation: The post-training phase employs a Context-RL mechanism, using mixed-modal reference information to construct dense, fine-grained reward signals. This enables factuality supervision at a hyper-geometric distribution level, effectively suppressing hallucinations and ensuring the stability of long-range reasoning.

keyQuotes: Kuaishou Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B is the first to introduce the DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) mechanism into multimodal understanding scenarios, successfully unlocking deep perception of a 256K ultra-long context and achieving nearly lossless inference capabilities in long video temporal perception.
True long video understanding is a comprehensive insight into complex plot twists, spatial jumps, and emotional undercurrents.
Benchmark scores are not the endgame; real-world deployment is.
The model not only sees the images but also comprehends the causality behind them.

relatedArticles.title: KAT-Coder-V2 Technical Report: Building Agentic Coding Models via the 'Specialize-then-Unify' Paradigm
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou releases the KAT-Coder-V2 coding model, which integrates five domain-specific expert capabilities through a 'Specialize-then-Unify' paradigm, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like SWE-bench.

relatedArticles.title: From 8% to 60% Generation Rate: The Four-Stage Evolution of Kuaishou's Intelligent Test Case Generation System
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the four-stage technical evolution of Kuaishou's intelligent test case generation system—from prompt engineering to multi-agent collaboration, knowledge enhancement, and self-evolution—sharing practical experience in boosting AI generation rates from 8% to 60%.

relatedArticles.title: Tair and SGLang Jointly Build a Hierarchical Cache Architecture for DeepSeek V4
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the hierarchical cache architecture built by the Alibaba Cloud Tair KVCache team and the SGLang community for DeepSeek V4. Through three core components—Shadow Radix, HiCache, and HiSparse—it addresses the logical description of KV Cache in long-context inference, prefix reuse during the Prefill phase, and GPU memory bottlenecks during the Decode phase, respectively.

relatedArticles.title: MiniMax M3: Cutting-edge Coding, 1M Context, Native Multimodal — All in One Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax releases the M3 model, integrating cutting-edge coding capabilities, 1M ultra-long context, and native multimodality, making it the first domestic model to combine these features, and it has been open-sourced.

relatedArticles.title: Extracting Audio Embedding Models from Multimodal Large Language Models
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Jina AI proposes a new paradigm for building high-performance, lightweight (1.1B) audio embedding models at extremely low data costs by "disassembling and recombining" Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) components.

relatedArticles.title: From 7.9% to 54% Adoption: The Three-Stage Evolution of Kuaishou's Intelligent Code Review
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the three-generation architectural evolution of Kuaishou's intelligent code review system—from pure LLM heuristics to knowledge engine-driven, and finally to Agentic autonomous decision-making—increasing the CR adoption rate from 7.9% to 54%.

relatedArticles.title: Kuaishou's Ad System Enters the Era of Generative Recommendation! GR4AD: Full-Chain Reconstruction from Token to Revenue
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou has launched the GR4AD system, achieving full-chain reconstruction and performance breakthroughs in large-scale advertising scenarios for generative recommendation through unified semantic IDs, lazy autoregressive decoding, and ranking-guided reinforcement learning.

relatedArticles.title: AI x Frontend Performance & Stability: Intelligent Diagnosis Practices at Kuaishou with 100M+ DAU
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou has developed the 'Conan AI' platform, which leverages an Agent architecture to deeply integrate low-level troubleshooting tools, enabling intelligent diagnosis and emergency mitigation for frontend performance and stability at a 100M+ DAU scale.

relatedArticles.title: Xiaohongshu Open-Sources FireRed-OCR: 2B Parameter Model Tops Document Parsing Leaderboard
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaohongshu has open-sourced the 2B-parameter FireRed-OCR model, which achieves performance surpassing ultra-large-scale general models in document parsing through innovative three-stage training and format-constrained reinforcement learning.
